method: Each site captured on the real GPU (Edge, Intel Iris Xe, D3D11 WebGL; no WebGPU adapter on this machine) at 1440x900: a first frame at 4 s, a settled frame at 12 s, an attempt to pass gates, a pointer sweep, a drag, four scroll steps, an arrow-key hold, plus an iPhone 13 view. Judged by Claude from the contact sheets (sheet-<id>.jpg) on 1 Nov 2026. Scores are 1-5. 'clean_premium' was added after Keshav asked for clean and premium, not only unique.

axes.visual: Art direction: composition, material, light, colour, typography.
axes.interaction: How original and meaningful the visitor's agency is.
axes.clean_premium: Restraint and finish: does it feel expensive and calm?
axes.first_frame: What a visitor sees in the first 4 s on real hardware.

sites.seen: A sculpted igloo on a snowfield in near-monochrome; scrolling breaks it into a floating ice crystal, then a carved logo ring.
sites.compelling: One material (ice) held for the whole film; photographic snow; the restraint of grey-blue.
sites.for_keshav: The discipline of one material and one palette.

sites.seen: 000 to 079 loader on black, then physics-piled blue and white crosses in a rounded card, then a standard agency page.
sites.compelling: The physics pile is tactile.
sites.derivative: Percentage loader; 'Bold ideas, brought to life'; Play Reel.
sites.for_keshav: Little; the shell is generic.

sites.seen: Googly-eyes enter gate on pink, then a pastel surreal room of arches, water and a sphere with 'Creating the unexpected'.
sites.compelling: Colour control; the eyes give it a personality before any 3D.
sites.for_keshav: A small character moment before content is cheap and memorable.

sites.seen: Black, then a glass ring with particles; scroll bursts into particles and becomes glass project cards.
sites.compelling: Transitions between scenes are seamless.
sites.for_keshav: Avoid.

sites.seen: A plain line of type on pale grey; the pointer raises a white plaster bas-relief of birds and flowers out of the page; project films sit in the relief as you scroll.
sites.compelling: Monochrome relief that reacts to the cursor; editorial serif; the page feels carved, not rendered.
sites.derivative: Little. The cursor-reveal is common, the material is not.
sites.for_keshav: Proof that 'premium' and 'interactive' can be the same thing: quiet first frame, one material, the visitor's hand shapes it.

sites.seen: A framed title on black, then a Renaissance painting collage with modern props; past the gate, a field of scattered slash-commands (/bundle-finder, /checkout-drops) on parchment, then torn-paper transitions into oil-painting scenes holding phones and code, with huge words (Agentic, Online).
sites.compelling: Art-historical collage as a coherent system; torn paper as the transition; serif and sans paired with real wit; very expensive.
sites.derivative: Not repeatable by one person at this production level.
sites.for_keshav: Frame-within-frame and torn-paper transitions; one strong visual metaphor applied to dry product news.

sites.seen: A technical-drawing loader of a cork ring, then a photoreal cork coaster on a green cutting mat; scroll turns it into a hero object on dark brown with 'Isn't just a coaster.'
sites.compelling: Photoreal tactility; a drafting-table metaphor; the joke of treating a coaster like a product launch.
sites.for_keshav: The drafting-table and technical-drawing language suits an engineer, and it is calm and expensive.

sites.seen: 'Loading' for 15 s, then a grey point-cloud tree with a 'SCANNING' HUD.
sites.compelling: The tree model.
sites.for_keshav: Avoid.

sites.capture: failed twice (loading for more than 80 s on a real GPU)
sites.seen: A title card with a leaf drawing and 'Best experience with headphones'; still loading after 60 s.
sites.compelling: Typography of the title card.
sites.for_keshav: Recapture.

sites.seen: A clay character in underpants holding a cup beside hand-lettered 'Food for Fish'; mobile says 'No mobile for now, try a desktop with WebGPU'.
sites.compelling: Character and humour; honest mobile notice.
sites.derivative: Nothing obvious; it's a one-off voice.
sites.for_keshav: Tone, not form.

sites.seen: A blue CRT boot screen as the loader, then a period computer on a moody desk, an office of beige PCs, a page-curl into an 80s brochure with a staff photo.
sites.compelling: A single governing fiction (an 80s computer company) carried from loader to footer; the loader is a feature.
sites.derivative: Retro nostalgia is popular, but the commitment is rare.
sites.for_keshav: A fiction committed to completely; the boot screen solves the loader problem.

sites.seen: Two red eyes on black, a WASD prompt, then a top-down neon city you move through.
sites.compelling: A playable city by one developer.
sites.for_keshav: Avoid the look.

sites.capture: failed twice ([ ENTER ] is drawn in the canvas, so it cannot be clicked automatically)
sites.seen: A counter, then '[ ENTER ]' on black.
sites.for_keshav: Recapture.

sites.seen: Orbiting dots on navy, then past the gate an aerial view of a research ship crossing the ocean while chapter cards change as you scroll.
sites.compelling: A single top-down camera; the ship moves with your scroll.
sites.derivative: Loader; globe on the gate page.
sites.for_keshav: Scroll as travel through one continuous scene.

sites.seen: A Venice photograph with a huge 'Digital' cut at the fold; scroll moves to white space with sparse portrait photography, then a Play Reel.
sites.compelling: Instant, photographic, typographic, calm; generous whitespace.
sites.derivative: The agency template (big word, photo, reel).
sites.for_keshav: The baseline for 'premium': instant first frame, huge type, photography, space.

sites.seen: A lime splash, then a white portrait whose helmet wipes away with the pointer over faint topographic lines; scroll goes to a dark band with a signature, then a scattered photo field.
sites.compelling: Cursor-as-visor reveal; a tight system (lime, topo lines, serif plus grotesk, signature); feels expensive.
sites.for_keshav: The reveal mechanic: the cursor uncovers a second layer of the same subject.

sites.seen: Studio name on black, a particle body, then a dense dark grid of project thumbnails.
sites.compelling: Volume of work.
sites.for_keshav: Little.

sites.seen: Loading dial, then a sea and sky scene; past the gate it becomes a guided breathing exercise: 'Take a minute to relax and breathe in time with the rolling waves', with ocean facts.
sites.compelling: Pacing the visitor's breathing to the waves is a genuine mechanic.
sites.for_keshav: Pacing as interaction.

sites.seen: A wordmark, then a black grid with floating primitives and a sentence, then a glossy black tapir mascot through maximalist kinetic-type scenes and a crowd of figures, ending on vertical Japanese text.
sites.compelling: Fearless art direction; each scroll step is a new poster.
sites.for_keshav: Energy, not form; too loud for 'premium'.

sites.capture: full (second attempt; Enter Experience is drawn in the canvas)
sites.seen: Wordmark on black, then a sepia château gate in volumetric light with a classic serif title.
sites.compelling: Luxury restraint; sepia, light rays, serif.
sites.for_keshav: Recapture past the gate.

sites.capture: partial twice (BEGIN is drawn in the canvas)
sites.seen: A loader, then a tiny planet whose buildings spell MESSENGER, slowly rotating, with a BEGIN button.
sites.compelling: The title is built from the world.
sites.for_keshav: Recapture.

sites.seen: One saturated blue field; the globe is made of green station dots; dragging tunes live radio (it started Chennai).
sites.compelling: Two colours, no chrome; the world is the control.
sites.for_keshav: An interface whose entire visual identity is its data.

sites.seen: A plain blue blog header, then black canvases with sliders that change the light simulation as you read.
sites.compelling: Explanation through manipulation.
sites.for_keshav: The mechanic matters more than the look; the look is plain.

sites.seen: A horizontal strip of white cards on light grey: a name sentence over a yellow circle, then giant cropped words (Craft, Projects), a pixel hand, field notes, and 'Make it fast. Make it beautiful…'.
sites.compelling: Confident, almost no colour, every element exact; instant first frame; scroll is horizontal and feels designed.
sites.for_keshav: The closest thing to a clean, premium engineer's personal site.

sites.seen: A BIOS boot (the loader), a start dialog, then a soft-lit desk with a beige computer; the camera moves into the monitor, which runs a real portfolio OS.
sites.compelling: One fiction; the loader is part of it; the render is clean and soft, not gamey.
sites.for_keshav: A software engineer's portfolio as a machine you use.

sites.seen: Columns of ASCII text over an animated text-mode field.
sites.compelling: Text-mode purity.
sites.for_keshav: Too raw for 'premium'.

sites.seen: An illustrated pink cinema box office with a clerk, posters and tickets; captions change as you wait.
sites.compelling: The concept reads instantly; Wes Anderson palette.
sites.for_keshav: Instant concept, but illustration-led.

sites.seen: A '64' counter, then a dark canvas: one framed project in the centre with tilted thumbnails at the corners; scrolling swaps the centre project; live 'someone joined' presence.
sites.compelling: Spatial, calm, dark; projects as objects on a desk.
sites.for_keshav: Project index as a physical table, with live presence.

sites.seen: A spinner on lavender, then a low-poly pastel globe with flocks of paper planes.
sites.compelling: The throw-and-catch idea.
sites.for_keshav: Little visually.

sites.seen: A white page, a pixel-mono masthead, serif body and blue isometric exploded diagrams (floppy disk, CRT, keyswitch, hard drive), a chapter index and a progress bar.
sites.compelling: One illustration language; reads like an expensive technical manual; instant.
sites.for_keshav: The strongest single reference for an engineer: technical drawing as the visual identity.

sites.seen: A glowing ring on a dark grid, then a diorama with 'Click to start', then a drivable pink-orange world with his name in 3D letters.
sites.compelling: Portfolio as a game; total commitment.
sites.derivative: Now the most copied portfolio idea on the web.
sites.for_keshav: Avoid copying; the idea is taken.

sites.seen: A mascot loader, then an empty purple field with 'read now'; mobile shows the comic cover.
sites.compelling: Comic illustration.
sites.for_keshav: Little.

sites.capture: failed twice (froze at 069; on 1 Nov in software GL it showed its no-WebGPU fallback instead, so the D3D11 path is worse than having no GPU)
sites.seen: A 000 to 069 counter, then frozen.
sites.for_keshav: Recapture; WebGPU-only.

sites.seen: Red field with black wave lines and 'CREATIVE + DEVELOPER' in condensed type; scroll becomes a perspective grid of awards, a 'WORK' pill, then a tunnel of letters.
sites.compelling: A complete two-colour graphic system; instant.
sites.for_keshav: System thinking in two colours.

sites.seen: A crumpled-paper loader, then a pencil-sketch brick house with a PORTFOLIO door covered in tech stickers.
sites.compelling: Paper material.
sites.for_keshav: Little.

sites.seen: Black, then a golden point-cloud of a building beside a menu; entering gives an editorial paper layout: 'Hues of Al'Ula' with photographs, diagrams and orbiting image clusters.
sites.compelling: Warm editorial layout meets a point-cloud; feels like a monograph.
sites.for_keshav: Research presented like a monograph; a point-cloud as the frontispiece.

sites.capture: failed twice (the loader reached 83 after about 80 s; mobile loaded the project list)
sites.seen: Name and a counter stuck at 17 on cream.
sites.for_keshav: Recapture.

sites.seen: Black with grain; white circular portals show each project's mark as a silhouette; scroll moves through them (Stone & Style, Drift, Aircord, Garden Eight, Maxilla).
sites.compelling: Stark black and white; one shape (the circle) as the whole system; very premium.
sites.for_keshav: A one-shape system for a project index.

sites.seen: A giant black 'NOTHIN'' on white; a chrome-and-black sculpted figure dives through the letters on hover; scroll turns to dark project mockups and surreal photography.
sites.compelling: Brutal-clean type with one sculptural intruder.
sites.for_keshav: Black-on-white type with one 3D object breaking it.

sites.seen: Near-black page, a short sentence headline and the real product UI as the hero; later a system diagram drawn in boxes and lines, then colour-block customer quote cards.
sites.compelling: Exact spacing and grey ramps; the product itself is the image.
sites.derivative: Now the template for every dark SaaS page.
sites.for_keshav: Show the real thing (the actual UI or diagram) instead of an illustration of it.

sites.capture: partial (a newsletter 'Continue' click jumped to the footer)
sites.seen: The ribbon-gradient hero with a running global-GDP counter, a long headline and a logo row.
sites.compelling: A live number in the hero; the gradient as a signature.
sites.for_keshav: One live, true number as a hero detail.

sites.seen: White page, playful sticker-like characters around 'Your favorite crypto wallet.', then phone screens on soft grey.
sites.compelling: Warmth inside a strict white layout.
sites.for_keshav: Personality in small objects, not in the layout.

sites.seen: One product photographed under a spotlight on black with a dense, tiny, technical nav; scrolling follows its long shadow into a joke: 'This shadow is unrealistically long… are you hiding something?'.
sites.compelling: Object photography as the whole page; deadpan wit; industrial typography.
sites.for_keshav: Premium plus a dry joke, which is rare and memorable.

sites.seen: A red glass-streak hero on near-black with 'Your shortcut to everything.', then dark cards.
sites.compelling: Strong single colour accent.
sites.derivative: Dark SaaS with a glowing hero object.
sites.for_keshav: Little beyond Linear.

sites.capture: full (the site is now 'A farewell to Arc')
sites.seen: The Arc mark and 'A farewell to Arc' in serif on black, a letter signed by the team in handwriting, then a white timeline and FAQ.
sites.compelling: Serif plus handwriting signatures; humane and calm.
sites.for_keshav: Handwritten signatures as a humane touch on a clean page.

sites.seen: A single narrow column of small text on white: name, a sentence with an italic, three columns (Building, Projects, Writing), Now, Connect.
sites.compelling: Absolute restraint; every word placed.
sites.for_keshav: The floor for 'clean': fine, but not exciting on its own.

sites.seen: Same pattern as Paco: a narrow text column of Today, Projects and Writing with soft hover highlights.
sites.compelling: Hover states are exact.
sites.for_keshav: As Paco.
